public_rationale: The August campus agreement and September IPO filing are material counterevidence to the categorical dismissal. They do not establish completion of the full sequence, including the public offering. No deadline was given, and the cited records establish neither completion nor definitive abandonment. Under a literal reading that no component would happen, the agreement would weigh more strongly against Zitron; that interpretation must remain visible.
limitations: The outcome depends on whether the forecast concerns any component or the complete arrangement.
An announced lease and planned capacity do not establish an operating campus.
IPO registration does not establish a completed listing.
